verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes general payment collection via the API and from an app or website, plus optimal payment routing. No item documents a vendor-hosted checkout page that a developer can redirect customers to, or says that no custom payment UI is needed. Payment routing is an adjacent feature, not a hosted checkout, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI
